detail.longDescription: Google has open-sourced the Elephant-Goldfish Model plugin, a review layer for AI coding agents. A long-running agent drafts the spec, then stateless subagents with no chat history attack it across five review stages before any code is written. Google says thousands of its engineers use it, though no accuracy benchmark exists. https://www. marktechpost.com/2026/11/08/go ogle-elephant-goldfish-model-plugin-spec-review-coding-agents/ # AIagent # AI # GenAI # AgenticAI
